scope: Keyboard shortcuts, focus restoration and accessible names for the desktop controls
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image (Qt 6.12.0, offscreen), docker --network none

desktop.note: One of two other runs failed only private-graph captures (pre-#123 harness); desktop-session passed in every run

verified_behaviors: Shortcut table has no duplicate key sequence (platform Undo/Redo bindings expanded)
Space toggles transport only when no text field, button, check box or combo box would use it; in a text field Space types and Ctrl+Z edits text
Ctrl+S saves, Ctrl+Shift+A/M add tracks, Ctrl+E exports; shortcuts are inactive while the Rename dialog is open

Keyboard deletion moves focus to the replacing track's Delete button, then the previous one, then Add audio track; Escape returns focus to the Rename opener; Undo/Redo leave focus on a visible control
With four tracks, every visible interactive control exposes a non-empty, unique accessible name and a role; a checked Mute box reports checked
limits: Offscreen synthetic events and QAccessible queries only; no screen reader or native Wayland input. Adding or deleting tracks rebuilds the track strip.
